rule: FROZEN BEFORE type/wait_for/screenshot WERE BUILT, from the measured baseline in docs/BASELINE-TYPE-WAIT.md. HR-20: an acceptance bar written after the build is a description of what was built.
whatTheLibraryAlreadyHandles: fill replaces existing content and fires focus+input; pressSequentially fires per-keystroke events; contenteditable works; readonly/disabled/number-with-text are all REFUSED; waitFor and waitForFunction bound correctly; screenshot returns a real Buffer. NONE of this is re-implemented.

criteria.must: type has no force. Measured: fill(readonly,{force:true}) SUCCEEDS and changes nothing — HR-19, the second verb where the same flag lied.
input[type=password] is REFUSED outright. Not redacted, not warned — refused, before anything is typed.
the audit record NEVER carries the typed value. Length and a shape class only.
readonly / disabled / gone / wrong-type each produce a NAMED reason, never an opaque timeout
the element is confirmed to be the one read_page named BEFORE anything is typed
same sealed order as navigate and click; an absent order blocks everything
type never presses Enter and never submits. Typing and submitting are different acts and only one of them is built.
wait_for always has a timeout and can never wait forever
a wait that times out is a STATED outcome, never silently treated as the condition having been met
wait_for accepts named conditions only — no page-evaluated predicate from a caller, which would be arbitrary code execution wearing a wait
a screenshot is never the primary record; role + accessible name is. The record references it, never replaces the vocabulary.
screenshots are size-bounded and the bound is stated when hit

acceptanceBar: T1-T7, W1-W3, S1-S2 green as tests, PLUS a LIVE HEADED run against the local hazard page showing readonly and disabled REFUSED WITH NAMED REASONS, a password field REFUSED, and a real typed value absent from the record.
whyLiveIsRequired: HR-20. On click, 17 green unit tests accompanied a live run that returned UNKNOWN three times, because the fake accepted what the real page.evaluate rejects.
